vsam.why: base/cntl/adef121.jcl DEFINE2: DATA(... KEYS(21 0) RECORDSIZE(64 64)); the engine's facts do not read KEYS / RECORDSIZE inside the DATA component, so the case states them

region.why: a deployment fact: LGIPVS01 ASSIGNs SYSID (unused afterwards); GenApp names no region in the corpus

scenarios.name: link-key-on-file
scenarios.why: COMMA-DATA-TEXT 'M0000000002': READ GENERIC GTEQ reads motor policy 1 of customer 2 (NORMAL, type M): COMMA-DATA gets 'Policy Key=' and M00000000020000000001

scenarios.name: link-next-key
scenarios.why: no motor policy of customer 3: GTEQ reads M0000000005/0000000003 (NORMAL, still type M): its key goes back

scenarios.name: link-other-type
scenarios.why: no endowment policy at or after customer 9: GTEQ reads a house policy, a type other than E: 'Policy Bad=' and 13 / 13

scenarios.name: link-past-the-end
scenarios.why: no key at or after M0000000011: NOTFND: 'Policy Bad=' and 13 / 13

scenarios.name: terminal-key-on-file
scenarios.why: the case's STARTCODE 'D' overridden to 'TD' (a terminal task) with the operator's input 'LGPF M0000000002': IF WS-STARTCODE(1:1) = 'D' is false and INVOKINGPROG is blank, so the RECEIVE arm runs, WS-FLAG 'R', then SEND TEXT (the false side of l.90 and the true side of l.130)

notes: GenApp's VSAM policy key inquiry LGIPVS01 as a distributed program link (the COMMAREA sibling of genapp-lgipvs01, which covers the terminal path). No GenApp program LINKs LGIPVS01, so the program's own test for a called run -- IF WS-STARTCODE(1:1) = 'D' or WS-Invokeprog Not = Spaces -- is reached by STARTCODE 'D' (IBM: a task started for a distributed program link; X19), the one fact a harness can state without a calling program in the corpus. The key then comes from COMMA-DATA (policy type + 10 customer digits in COMMA-DATA-TEXT), WS-RECV-LEN = 10, no RECEIVE; the same READ FILE('KSDSPOLY') GENERIC GTEQ; the answer goes back into COMMA-DATA (text 'Policy Key=' / 'Policy Bad=' and the 21-byte key) and the task RETURNs with no SEND TEXT. Not exercised: the non-blank INVOKINGPROG arm of that test (it needs a calling program, and no corpus program LINKs LGIPVS01; the STARTCODE arm takes the same statements). Data: ksdspoly.txt is the genapp-lgupdb01 case's ten GenApp sample policies.
